test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in superlative degree of comparison.**

This type is the quiet and most efficient style of humidifier.

options.text: This type is the quiet and efficient style of humidifier.
This type is the quietest and most efficient style of humidifier.
This humidifier is the quieter style of.

solution:
The correct answer is: **This type is the quietest and most efficient style of humidifier**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The superlative degree of comparison is used to compare one thing with many others of its kind.
 
• In this sentence, we need to compare this type of humidifier with all other styles of humidifiers.
 
• The superlative form of the adjective '**quiet**' is '**quietest**' and the superlative form of '**efficient**' is '**most efficient**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct superlative form of the sentence is '*This type is the quietest and most efficient style of humidifier*'.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer
